title: Ask HN: What is your dev set up like?
text: Developer wants to 'push a job to the web' when leaving work but finds deployment/API keys to be the bottleneck. Relevant for automated deploy gating.

title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
text: Orchestration system that handles the full ticket-to-PR lifecycle, including squashing and merging. Directly intersects with PP's deploy-gate wedge.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
text: Control layer for agents with CI gate support and behavioral monitoring. Specifically claims OpenClaw support.

title: This new Claude Code Review tool uses AI agents to check your pull requests for bugs
text: Anthropic announced a Code Review beta for Teams/Enterprise. Uses agents to analyze PRs for bugs.

title: Show HN: Sweet! CLI – Cheaper alternative to Claude Code or Codex CLI
text: Mentions 'autopilot' for monitoring live applications and detecting outages. Shows intent for agents to handle production monitoring.
